note: Both sets cover the same wiring-schedule rows and properties with identical values, and share the same core error: "CU: #12/2WG." is bound to item 151, but the schedule shows it under item 10 (151 is "AL: 3#4/0, ARMORED CABLE"), and the 151 description is used as the quote for the "Wiring 150 | AL" claim while the 150 spec survives only as a vague "cable | specification". A and B are otherwise equivalent in coverage and correctness. B's only addition is a spurious "conditions: C." on three conduit-size claims ("C." is the abbreviation for conduit in "1\"C.", not an operating condition), so A is marginally cleaner and more faithful.
remarks: The text layer is badly jumbled (row numbers appear after or between descriptions, e.g. "34 151 AL: 3#4/0, ARMORED CABLE 10 CU: #12/2WG."), which is the likely cause of the 150/151/10 scrambling in both sets; the page image clearly shows rows 151, 150, 50, 34, 33, 32, 31, 20, 10. Both sets also omit the NOTES block (MAIN PANEL MP 120/240V, 1-phase 3-wire, 150A/2P main breaker with main bonding jumper, 200A/2P NFDS in NEMA 3R enclosure) and the "4 AWG, COPPER TO GND" grounding conductor, and neither states item 10 as its own claim. The margin between the sets is small: B's only defect is the mis-parsed "C." abbreviation recorded as a condition.
